integrity: The new far-tail inequality is proved by an exact point-mass factorization valid for every integer n>6. Simmons' classical inequality is used only for the first left-loading coefficient and was checked against two independent literature statements. Finite computation is supplementary only.
limitations: The theorem settles only the mean-three slice of the binomial left-loadedness conjecture; it does not address arbitrary integer means.
title: The mean-three case of the binomial left-loadedness conjecture
